title: DPO dataset: 262 triples (prompt/chosen/rejected)
body: The DPO (Direct Preference Optimization) dataset contains 262 triples. 8 additional peer-review DPO pairs were extracted by FX-008 from 752 tasks: 609 with approvals, 5 with rejections, 5 with both. Chosen = last output before approval; rejected = last output before rejection signal.
